response.sql: WITH st AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS a FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation), o AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS g FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(st.a) AS mean_bandwidth_usage, AVG(st.a - o.g) AS mean_excess_over_average FROM st, o WHERE st.a > o.g
